static_traits.name: Chen Ying
static_traits.occupation: Working mother (with two high school sons)
static_traits.family_status: Living with husband and two sons attending high school
static_traits.social_status: Gets along fairly well with her husband, but feels alienated from the friend group and believes she is judged
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no similar psychological problems or treatment history in the past
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, cooperative but skeptical attitude; tends toward negative self-evaluation (such as 'I fail in every aspect'), has mind reading and predictive assumptions, accompanied by overgeneralization

basic_info.main_problem: I feel lost, estranged from my true self, especially in my role as a mother; these feelings intensified after the children started high school, and are especially obvious when work keeps me from accompanying the children.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling at this time because I realize this sense of estrangement is affecting my mental health and my relationship with my family; I also 'just want to enjoy life and family without being constantly judged'.
growth_experiences: A few years ago after the two sons entered high school, the children's needs and schedules changed; balancing work and motherhood became harder. Previously felt more in control and more connected with family and friends, but then the gradually intensifying sense of being lost and estranged became more obvious in daily life, especially at work.

special_situations.event: At a gathering with friends, hears them talk about their children and notices their gazes
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If friends talk about their children and I am not as invested as them, it means I have failed as a mother
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing contact with friends; staying defensive when meeting, trying hard to prove oneself a competent mother
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They look down on me, thinking I do very poorly

special_situations.event: Busy at work, traveling for work and having not accompanied the children
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am not by my children's side, I am an incompetent mother, disappointing the children
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeated self-reflection (journaling), self-blame, trying to compensate by performing doubly well
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I did wrong again, I am not a good mother

special_situations.event: Thinks of verifying one's worries with friends (direct communication)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I express my feelings, they will deny them or think I am too sensitive
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding verification, staying silent to avoid embarrassment or being negated
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Pointless, they will only deny it

special_situations.event: Imbalance or small mistakes occur amid the role conflict between work and motherhood
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not do well in one area, it means I fail in all areas
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Berating oneself with all-or-nothing standards, reduced contact through socializing
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I have failed in every way

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be accepted and recognized by friends, to be seen as good enough as a mother, and to stay connected with the 'true self'
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being judged as incompetent, excluded by the group, thus losing self-worth and belonging
defense_goal: Reducing the risk of being humiliated or negated by keeping distance from friends and avoiding verification
Staying defensive and self-proving in interactions to protect fragile self-esteem

object_relations.self_representation: Easily judged, a mother/outsider who may fail at any moment
object_relations.object_representation: Critical and judgmental group of friends

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor suggests verifying assumptions with friends and conducting behavioral experiments
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing others will negate or blame oneself (projecting inner self-criticism and sense of being judged onto others)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Responding in a cautious and negative tone, emphasizing 'they will deny it / I am too sensitive', refusing or delaying direct verification.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When with friends, catches ambiguous glances or conversation cues
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Understanding these cues as negation and criticism of one's motherhood
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using self-blaming language (such as 'I'm no good / I failed'), avoiding expressing disappointment or anger toward others, lowering self-worth.

manifestations: Feels alienated from the friend group, believing oneself is being judged
Avoids or stays defensive in interactions, reducing contact
outcomes: Increased sense of isolation, rising anxiety
Decreased sense of self-worth, relationships growing more distant

manifestations: Repeatedly feeling estranged from 'the true self'
Lost between mother and work roles, finding it hard to define oneself
outcomes: Worsening sense of loss and confusion

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Insisting in counseling that friends are judging oneself, concluding verification is meaningless
Experiencing inner self-criticism as negation from others

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Frequent self-blame (e.g. 'I fail in every aspect')
Cautious and defensive in interactions with people, hard to spontaneously express true needs

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Not verifying with friends or expressing confusion and dissatisfaction, turning to self-blame instead
Digesting emotions through self-reflection and self-blame rather than building connections outward

positive_force: Valuing family relationships and having motivation to seek help
Willing to try behavioral experiments amid doubt, willing to collect evidence to correct views
Gets along fairly well with the husband; some intimate-relationship support exists
negative_force: Overly dependent on external evaluation (worries about how friends view oneself)
Mind-reading and predicting the future leading to misunderstanding and avoidance
All-or-nothing thinking and overgeneralization, aggravating the sense of failure
Avoiding socializing and not verifying assumptions, reinforcing negative beliefs
Self-critical tendencies, lowering self-esteem and sense of connection

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids friends and acts defensive when meeting, trying to prove oneself
antecedent: Meeting friends in person or interacting online
Hears friends talk about their children, notices the other person's gaze or tone
target_behavior.core_reason: Fearing being judged as an incompetent mother, based on mind-reading and reliance on external recognition
target_behavior.function: Avoiding the anxiety brought by being judged, gaining temporary psychological security
target_behavior.consequence: Relationships growing more distant, loneliness and the belief of being judged reinforced

target_behavior.behavior: Negative self-talk and self-belittlement (such as 'I fail in every aspect')
antecedent: Work takes up time with the children
After role conflicts or small mistakes
target_behavior.core_reason: The internalized rule that 'a good mother should always be present' and black-and-white thinking
target_behavior.function: Maintaining a sense of control through self-punishment, finding an interpretation for anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Increased emotional burden, lowered confidence, further affecting connections with family and friends
